interpretation: Absolute-prefix interfaces fit the short-chain context almost perfectly but transfer worse than the coarser multiset. The supported-prefix interface has a higher finite-population ceiling than the multiset, so the reversal is decoder extraction rather than information loss. The effect persists on CLUTRR lengths 4--5 but not on D8 at matched small contexts.
scientific_role: post-hoc shortcut diagnostic with matched-shift and independent-algebra boundary checks
